Rivian opens its first fast-charging hub in Europe

Published 2026-10-07 08:15 UTC

Rivian has opened its first fast-charging site outside North America, a 24-stall hub near Amsterdam that is open to any electric vehicle with a CCS2 connector. The company plans to start European deliveries of its R2 SUV next year.

The site is part of the Rivian Adventure Network, which has more than 100 locations in the US and Canada. Rivian says it chose the Netherlands because of the country's high rate of EV adoption and dense charging demand along motorways.

Charging costs EUR 0.49 per kWh, with lower rates for Rivian owners. The company did not say how many more European sites it plans to open before the R2 arrives.
